title: VPN disconnects for remote users
matches: VPN connection drops every few minutes
VPN keeps disconnecting when working from home
symptoms: VPN tunnel drops every few minutes, mostly on home Wi-Fi. User has to reconnect repeatedly.
cause: The VPN client's idle timeout and MTU are too aggressive for consumer routers, and older client versions (below 5.2) don't recover from Wi-Fi power saving.
resolution: Confirm the client version in the VPN app's About screen. Upgrade to the current approved version from Software Center if it is below 5.2.
Set the adapter MTU to 1400: run `netsh interface ipv4 set subinterface "VPN" mtu=1400 store=persistent` as admin.
Turn off Wi-Fi power saving: Device Manager > Network adapter > Power Management > untick 'Allow the computer to turn off this device'.
Ask the user to reconnect and stay connected for 15 minutes to confirm.
notes: If drops continue on a wired connection, escalate to Network Ops with the client log (%ProgramData%\VPN\logs).

title: Outlook not syncing email
matches: Outlook not syncing emails on laptop
Outlook emails not syncing since morning
symptoms: New mail stops arriving in Outlook desktop while Outlook on the web shows it. Status bar may say 'Disconnected' or 'Updating this folder'.
cause: A corrupted local OST cache file, or Cached Exchange Mode stuck after a password change.
resolution: Check Outlook on the web. If mail is there, the mailbox is fine and the problem is the local client.
Close Outlook, rename the .ost file in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Outlook to .ost.old.
Reopen Outlook and let it rebuild the cache (can take 10-30 minutes for large mailboxes).
If prompted, re-enter the password; clear old entries in Credential Manager first.
notes: If web mail is also missing messages, treat as a mail-flow incident and check the email server status (see KB0010003).

title: Email server outage
matches: Email server outage for all users
symptoms: Many users at once cannot send or receive email, in both Outlook and on the web.
cause: Mail service outage, usually a failed transport node or an expired TLS certificate on the mail gateway.
resolution: Raise a P1 major incident and post a status-page notice.
Check the mail gateway health dashboard and certificate expiry date.
Fail over to the secondary transport node if the primary is down.
Link all user reports to the major incident as child tickets instead of working them separately.
notes: Messaging on-call owns this. Every duplicate report should reference the parent P1.

title: SAP portal login fails (error 403)
matches: Unable to login to SAP portal
SAP portal login fails with error 403
symptoms: User gets error 403 or 'not authorized' when signing in to the SAP portal.
cause: The user's SAP role assignment expired, or the SSO token is cached from an old session.
resolution: Ask the user to sign in from a private browser window. If that works, clear browser cookies for the portal domain.
If it still fails, check the user in SU01 for locked status and role validity dates.
Extend or reassign the expired role (needs manager approval for new roles).
Ask the user to sign out and back in after 10 minutes for the role to sync.
notes: Locked accounts after 5 failed attempts are unlocked by the service desk; role changes go to SAP Support.

title: SAP report export to Excel not working
matches: SAP report export to Excel not working
symptoms: Export to spreadsheet in SAP GUI does nothing or opens an empty file.
cause: SAP GUI security settings block the Excel macro, or the export format default is set to an old XLS template.
resolution: In SAP GUI, Options > Security > Security Settings, set the rule for the export path to Allow.
In the report, choose List > Export > Spreadsheet, then pick 'Excel (in Office 2007 XLSX format)' and tick 'Always use selected format'.
Update SAP GUI to the approved version if it is older than 7.70.

title: Payroll application down
matches: Payroll application down for all users
symptoms: Payroll application shows a server error or will not load for everyone.
cause: Usually the application server hit its database connection limit during a payroll run, or a scheduled patch did not finish.
resolution: Raise a P1 and inform HR leadership; payroll deadlines may be affected.
Check the app server and database connection pool in monitoring.
Restart the application service in the documented order (app, then integration service).
Confirm with one HR user that they can sign in, then link duplicate reports to the P1.

title: Workday password reset and timesheet page
matches: Workday password reset request
Workday timesheet page not loading
symptoms: User cannot sign in to Workday, or the timesheet page spins without loading.
cause: Workday uses company SSO, so password problems are usually the main company password. Timesheet hangs are a browser cache issue after a Workday release.
resolution: For sign-in: reset the company password through the self-service reset portal, then sign in to Workday through SSO.
For the timesheet page: clear cache and cookies for the Workday domain, or try a private window.
If only one user is affected after both steps, collect a screenshot and the time it happened, and route to HR Systems.

title: Laptop slow after Windows update
matches: Laptop running very slow after Windows update
symptoms: Laptop is very slow, fan running, for hours after a Windows update.
cause: Post-update tasks (search indexing, .NET optimization, antivirus full scan) run together, often on laptops with under 8 GB RAM.
resolution: Restart the laptop twice to let pending update steps finish.
Open Task Manager and check what is using CPU and disk. Leave indexing and scans to finish if they are running.
Run `sfc /scannow` as admin if slowness lasts more than a day.
If RAM is under 8 GB, raise a hardware upgrade request.

title: Printer on 3rd floor not printing
matches: Printer on 3rd floor not printing
symptoms: Jobs sit in the queue and nothing prints on the 3rd floor printer.
cause: A stuck job in the print server queue, or the printer has dropped off the network after a power cycle.
resolution: Check the printer's display for paper jams or errors.
On the print server, open the queue for the printer and delete the stuck first job.
Ping the printer's IP. If there is no reply, power cycle it and check the network cable.
Send a test page.

title: Shared drive access denied
matches: Shared drive access denied for finance folder
Access request for Salesforce reports
symptoms: User gets 'Access denied' on a shared folder or report they need.
cause: The user isn't in the security group that grants access, or was added recently and hasn't signed out since.
resolution: Check which group grants access to the folder or report.
If the user should have access, get approval from the data owner, then add them to the group.
Ask the user to sign out and back in (or lock and unlock) so the new group membership applies.
notes: Never grant access to individuals directly; always through a group.

title: Microsoft Teams audio, calls and screen sharing
matches: Teams meeting audio not working
Teams calls dropping after 5 minutes
Teams screen sharing not working
symptoms: No audio in Teams meetings, calls drop after a few minutes, or screen sharing shows a black screen.
cause: Wrong audio device selected, an outdated Teams client, or the VPN routing Teams traffic through the tunnel.
resolution: In Teams, Settings > Devices, pick the right speaker and microphone and make a test call.
Update Teams (profile menu > Check for updates) and restart it.
Clear the Teams cache: quit Teams, delete the contents of %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Teams, and reopen.
If calls drop only on VPN, confirm split tunnelling for Teams is on (see KB0010001).

title: Website checkout returns error 500
matches: Checkout page returning 500 error
Website checkout page throws 500 error on payment
symptoms: Customers see error 500 at checkout or when paying.
cause: Usually the payment provider's API is timing out, or a recent deployment broke the checkout service.
resolution: Raise a P1; this affects revenue.
Check the payment provider's status page and the checkout service error logs.
If a deployment went out in the last 2 hours, roll it back.
Link customer and internal reports to the P1 as duplicates.

title: Nightly database backup job failed
matches: Nightly database backup job failed
Database backup job failed overnight
symptoms: The nightly backup job ends with a failed status.
cause: The backup volume is full, or a long-running query held a lock past the backup window.
resolution: Check free space on the backup volume; remove backups older than the retention period.
Check the job log for lock timeout errors and find the blocking session.
Rerun the backup manually and confirm it completes.
If it fails two nights in a row, raise the priority to P2.
